mode: real RunDesk demo service and Chromium; explicit browser HTTP faults and synthetic runtime event; no real provider fault reproduced
checks: JSON HTTP 500 displays URL, method, status, request IDs, session, code and upstream cause; copy uses redacted content
repeated identical requests group with count, timestamps and recent correlation IDs
HTML 500 response remains inert text and is not discarded by JSON parsing
empty 502, HTTP 200 invalid JSON, and no-response network failure are distinguished without inventing a 500
oversized errors are bounded at 32 KiB with an explicit truncation indication
error history remains available after refresh in the same tab
errors inside settings dialogs have a reachable detail action without closing the original form
failed send retains the draft and exposes details; only manual retry occurs and keeps the same idempotency key; request body is excluded
runtime error card opens event details and does not mislabel an upstream 500 as a browser HTTP status
replayed event IDs do not inflate counts after runtime errors were grouped
SSE disconnect is recorded once per outage with unknown HTTP status
trace entry, 390px mobile details and Escape work without horizontal overflow
clear removes the current tab history
